data.title: Electricity price increase – tariff "Musterwatt Natur", effective 1 April 2027
data.summary: Musterwatt Energie GmbH informs Anton Musterschmidt that the prices of his electricity tariff "Musterwatt Natur" will rise from 1 April 2027, with the monthly advance payment (Abschlag) increasing from €74.00 to €81.00 due to higher grid fees (Netzentgelte).
data.explanation: Your electricity supplier, Musterwatt Energie, is raising its prices from 1 April 2027 because network fees charged by the grid operator have gone up. The per-kWh price, base fee and your monthly advance payment all increase. Because this is a price increase, you have a special right to cancel the contract without the normal notice period, effective on the date the new prices start — the app will show you until when you can decide and send that cancellation in writing (Textform) to the supplier. If you do nothing, the new, higher prices simply apply from that date; no fee is charged for cancelling.
